scenes: Sam Bankman-Fried lost sixteen billion dollars in days.
He ran F T X, one of the biggest crypto exchanges on Earth.
November sixth, twenty twenty-two. Binance's boss tweets he will sell all his F T X tokens.
Customers rush to pull their money out. F T X can't pay.
Binance offers to buy F T X, then walks away.
November eleventh: F T X goes bankrupt. About eight billion dollars of customer money is missing.
He was sentenced to twenty-five years in prison.
